changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0007. Create the role and permission catalog and tenant-scoped assignments. Index review: PK_Roles and UX_Roles_Name identify a role by its stable name; PK_Permissions and UX_Permissions_Code identify a permission by its machine code; PK_RolePermissions (RoleId, PermissionId) is the authorization join and IX_RolePermissions_PermissionId supports the permission foreign key; UX_UserRoles_UserId_RoleId_TenantId prevents a duplicate active assignment and leads with UserId because permission checks load the roles of one user in one tenant; IX_UserRoles_RoleId and IX_UserRoles_TenantId support those foreign keys, which the unique index does not lead with. Performance note: catalog tables stay small, and the user-role unique index is filtered to active rows.

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0008. Seed the Part 2 role and permission catalog. No user and no password is inserted. Index review: no new indexes; inserts use the unique name and code indexes. Performance note: the catalog is a few dozen rows and each insert is a point lookup.
